notes.title: Update 1.2, iOS Verison(Free!)
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30514700/124146ca28b10f2e54d2bda50f65a0560eca4187.png

Update 1.2 is live!

Here is the list of changes:

Fixed many small bugs
Improved performance
Improved quality of all icons in the interface
In the build mode interface is improved
Added a Steam Cloud for storing game saves


And an important change - now all the updates of the game are released immediately for Steam, and for iOS versions of the game.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30514700/a62663d1cc90b52bd4a3a4ad1cdba01ca619a9fe.png

iOS version
Regardless of whether you bought the game on Steam or not, you can get the game for FREE on your iOS device. Requires iOS 10.0 or later.

Download now:  https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/tryon-puzzle-memory-trainer/id1388310513

Version for android devices will be soon, stay tuned!

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
As was promised, in this update Build mode was added. Now you can create your own levels, share them with other players and try other's creations. 

For saving your level, in build mode you have to press left button on the top of the screen, so level's textcode is generated. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30514700/938f70b29bf11314558104e7b85e238f7b642441.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30514700/be8925bfae384bfe292a852a7c7f92597ad777df.png

To load your level, put this textcode in the input box and press right button on the top of the screen. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30514700/1b8d43b2bc41da4663bffaab56d06f0281743973.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30514700/98460473356584bff36638e705ce3d3b247265e1.png

To start level press Play. After finishing the level you will be returned to editor.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30514700/699f991798d80ae6b8a22fa7b20b4d8049dddca6.png
